dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "your_script.py"]
explanation: Requirements include the latest stable ccxt version (4.2.43) with core dependencies requests (for HTTP) and cryptography (for security). Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs requirements efficiently, and sets a default command assuming a main script exists.
